Curriculum vitae (PDF)

I am a Ph.D. student in the Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) group at Nanjing University, supervised by Prof. Penghui Yao. My research interests are quantum computing, quantum information, and quantum complexity theory.

Outside of research, I enjoy photography and learning languages. I am currently learning Japanese and French. Thanks to AI, I never run out of ways to learn and practice! I have also written a reusable AI-agent skill for building a Japanese learning website, available in my Japanese Study Studio project.

Japanese Study Studio

Sep. 2026

Personal Project · Python / JavaScript

Developed a local AI Japanese learning site in Python and JavaScript, integrating Codex CLI and Anki’s native review scheduling through AnkiConnect. Implemented interactive tutoring, persistent cross-session memory, and structured storage for learning records, textbooks, and supplementary reading materials.
